title: Site rules
introduction: SNEStorage is a community for SNES hacking, documentation, tools, and homebrew. These rules keep resources useful, creators credited, and the community welcoming.
contextDescription: Staff consider the context, intent, impact, and previous violations when reviewing an incident. Repeated violations may lead to more severe penalties.

sections.title: Community and public profiles
sections.description: Respect other users wherever you participate on SNEStorage.

rules.title: Do not harass other users
rules.text: Do not use SNEStorage to harass, intimidate, or deliberately bother other users.

rules.title: Keep your public profile appropriate
rules.text: Do not use your avatar or other public profile information to display political, controversial, offensive, or otherwise disturbing content.

rules.title: Language depends on context
rules.text: No word is prohibited solely for being a particular word. However, do not use language to deliberately provoke, insult, or upset other users. Context and intent matter.

sections.title: Resources and previews
sections.description: Describe and classify your resource accurately, and show what users will actually receive.

rules.title: Uploads must match their description
rules.text: Do not deliberately misrepresent an upload or include unrelated material. If you describe a resource as a particular tool or asset, the downloaded files must correspond to that resource.

rules.title: Apply the appropriate content warnings
rules.text: If your resource contains sensitive content, select all of the content warning flags that apply.

rules.title: SNES material only
rules.text: Only upload material relevant to the SNES, such as hacking resources, documentation, tools, and homebrew. Unrelated uploads are not allowed.

rules.title: Use previews to demonstrate the resource
rules.text: Previews must be relevant to the resource. Do not use them to upload unrelated or controversial content.

rules.title: Choose accurate classifications
rules.text: Use submission forms correctly. The game, resource types, categories, and other information must match the resource. For example, do not classify an enemy resource as a player resource.

rules.title: Provide precise information
rules.text: Be accurate and specific when filling out forms. Avoid vague descriptions or information that does not help users understand the resource.

sections.title: Safety, distribution, and authorship
sections.description: Share only material you are allowed to distribute, and give every contributor proper credit.

rules.title: No illegal material
rules.text: Do not upload illegal material to SNEStorage.

rules.title: Use safe and relevant links
rules.text: Do not put malicious links, links to dubious websites, or links unrelated to a form's purpose into any form.

rules.title: No ROM uploads: share BPS or IPS patches
rules.text: Uploading ROMs is strictly prohibited, except for homebrew that does not infringe copyright. To share a ROM hack or modified game, upload a BPS or IPS patch instead of the ROM. Do not include the original ROM with the patch.

rules.title: Get permission before sharing someone else's work
rules.text: Do not upload resources you did not create without permission to redistribute them. Crediting the author does not replace that permission.

rules.title: Credit every author
rules.text: When uploading a resource, list all of its authors, including contributors who do not have a SNEStorage account.

sections.title: Comments and discussions
sections.description: Keep discussions useful and relevant to the resource.

rules.title: Do not spam comments
rules.text: Do not post promotional links, unrelated or nonsensical messages, or repeated comments multiple times or across different resources.

rules.title: Sensitive discussions need a relevant context
rules.text: Discussions of sensitive subjects, such as politics or religion, are prohibited in comments unless they are relevant to the context of the resource or discussion.

rules.title: Write meaningful comments
rules.text: Vague or nonsensical comments may be removed.

sections.title: Visibility and resource permissions
sections.description: Private visibility does not remove staff access or the permissions of resource contributors.

rules.title: Who can view a private resource
rules.text: A private resource can be viewed by moderators and administrators, its authors, the user who submitted the resource, and anyone who previously submitted a version of it.

rules.title: Who can manage a resource
rules.text: Any resource author, the user who submitted the resource, and anyone who previously submitted a version of it may upload new versions, edit the resource, and delete it. Deleting resources or versions must follow the dependency and minimum-version rules in this section.

rules.title: Dependencies must remain accessible
rules.text: A private resource cannot be used as a dependency of another resource. A resource referenced as a dependency by another resource on SNEStorage cannot be made private. If another resource depends on your resource, you must speak with an administrator or moderator before deleting it.

rules.title: Keep at least one version
rules.text: An existing resource must always have at least one version. You may delete individual versions, but you must not delete the last remaining version.

sections.title: Moderation and repeated violations
sections.description: Staff review incidents in context rather than treating every mistake the same way.

rules.title: Repeated violations can lead to stronger penalties
rules.text: If a user breaks the rules more than once, penalties may become more severe. Staff determine the appropriate response based on the circumstances of each incident.
